pages: Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair, in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, crouches at the mouth of one wooden beehive box and counts the bees going in and coming out. Middle distance: a bee veil on a nail, a tin smoker. Background: the plank shed behind his grandfather's house. Grey morning daylight.

Inside the plank shed, Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, writes in one yellow pad held flat on his knee while bees stream past him. Middle distance: a white enamel mug, a pencil. Background: the shed doorway and bright spring field. Low afternoon sun.

Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, holds open one yellow pad and stares at the neat rows of tens filling four sheets, the last of them still bare. Middle distance: his grandfather's white enamel mug, a wristwatch. Background: the shed bench, spring light through the doorway.

On the counting Saturday Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, holds one small tin clock in both hands and stops its hand with his thumb. Middle distance: a yellow pad, a stack of hive boxes. Background: the shed window, a sack shading the glass.

Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, stands at the shed bench, one hand flat on the closed yellow pad, brow furrowed. Middle distance: stacked wooden hive boxes, a tin mug. Background: the far shed wall, a small window. Flat morning light.

Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, lifts one wooden frame thick with hexagonal comb and turns it slowly in the light. Middle distance: the open hive box, a pocket knife. Background: the shed wall and its hanging combs. Warm shaft of sunlight.

Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, stands in the shed doorway with his hand on the frame, watching bees stream out over the grass. Middle distance: a hive lid, a wheelbarrow. Background: the long grass and hedge beyond, full midday light.

Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, kneels beside one deep wooden hive box and rests a hand on its flat lid, watching bees settle low on the grass. Middle distance: pale capped honey frames, a folded veil. Background: the shed, low September sun.

In the cold shed, Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a thick grey wool coat, reaches up towards one dense brown cluster of bees clinging beneath the roof boards. Middle distance: stacked hive boxes, a bare bulb. Background: black frost on the shed window. Weak winter light.

Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a thick grey wool coat, lays one bare hand flat on a cold metal hive box lid, reading the chill. Middle distance: a wooden chair, a hanging oil lamp. Background: the white bee cluster under the dark roof boards, frost on the glass. Hard January light.

Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, holds up one wooden frame of honeycomb and studies the damp brown patch in its middle. Middle distance: an open hive box, a cloth. Background: the shed interior, thin spring light through the doorway.

At the kitchen table Bram, a boy of ten with short black hair in a faded green work shirt with the sleeves turned back, reads the last row of figures in one yellow pad and pushes it shut. Middle distance: a white enamel mug, a pencil laid down. Background: the kitchen window, low summer evening sun.
